Discount codes are costing more than they earn in our core retail categories: discounted orders return 5-7 points more often than full-price ones (e.g. apparel 39% vs 35%, electronics 17% vs 11%), with no real boost in order size.

Referral customers are our most engaged shoppers by far — people who refer others place ~8 orders/year vs ~3 for everyone else — while our loyalty program shows no such lift despite similar effort to run.
Growth is concentrated: just 2 of our ~120 merchants generate 31% of all "direct" site traffic, and only 1 in 7 orders can be traced back to a marketing channel at all.
